references.text: The same age requirement of thirty to fifty years for Levitical service is mentioned here for the sons of Gershon.
An identical age limit of thirty to fifty years is given for the sons of Kohath who were to perform work in the tent of meeting.
The same age requirement of thirty to fifty years is repeated for the sons of Gershon and their service in the tent of meeting.
The age limit of thirty to fifty years is mentioned again for the sons of Merari who were to serve in the tent of meeting.
Describes the age requirements for the Levites' service at the tent of meeting, with reference to twenty-five years and fifty years.
David counted the Levites from thirty years old and upward, referring to the traditional age for Levitical service.
Mentions a change in the age requirement for Levitical service to twenty years but confirms the earlier tradition.
